name: TrueSignal login attempt against a decoy
description: Someone tried to authenticate to a TrueSignal decoy service (LDAP/LDAPS, database, FTP/Telnet, web login). Decoys have no legitimate users, so any attempt is credential testing or use. SSH/RDP attempts are left to truesignal-lateral-movement and planted-credential use to truesignal-honeytoken-used.
author: TrueSignal
false_positives: Vulnerability scanners and asset-discovery tools with credential checks: add them to the Hub's known scanners.
Administrators testing a decoy. Use `truesignal firedrill` instead (source `Wizard Firedrill`).
note:
## Triage
1. `user.name` / `user.domain` is the account tried. Search your directory and real authentication logs for it from `source.ip`: the same credential is likely being tried on real systems.
2. `truesignal.source_asset` names the source host when it is inventoried; otherwise identify it via DHCP/EDR.
3. Passwords are HMAC'd (`truesignal.details.password_hmac`); compare with other decoy events to see whether the same password is sprayed.
4. Pivot on `source.ip` for other TrueSignal alerts (scan-then-touch, other decoys).
query: event.dataset:"truesignal.alert" and event.category:"authentication" and not event.action:"honeytoken_used" and not threat.tactic.id:"TA0008" and not truesignal.whitelisted:true and not truesignal.known_scanner:true
